title: Coaxial resistor (electric currents, analytic)
description:
Coaxial resistor cross-section: core (radius a) at V0, shield (every cell with r > b) at 0 V, resistive fill sigma_fill.
Analytic: V = V0 ln(b/r)/ln(b/a), J_r = sigma_fill V0/(r ln(b/a)), G' = 2 pi sigma_fill/ln(b/a) (S per m of depth).
Derived values tab: G_per_m (core current / voltage), I_shield (= -G' V0), P_joule (integral of q_joule = G' V0^2) and V_mid (probe next to r = sqrt(a b), about V0/2) with their references; expect ~0.5 % from the staircased circles (one cell of radius is ~3.6 %).
Line profile tab: V_radial (field V) and J_radial (field J_x) against the analytic curves. Field tab: V, J and q_joule maps.
Twin: coax_capacitor_electrostatics.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: core voltage [V]; the shield is held at 0 V

parameters.name: sigma_fill
parameters.description: DC conductivity of the resistive fill [S/m]

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain side; the shield fills every cell with r > b

parameters.name: x_c
parameters.description: axis x (a cell vertex, so the staircase is symmetric)

parameters.name: r_probe
parameters.description: probe radius: the cell centre just outside sqrt(a b), where V = V0/2

analytic_curves.name: V_radial
analytic_curves.expression: V0*log(b/min(max(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c), a), b))/log(b/a)

analytic_curves.name: J_radial
analytic_curves.expression: where((hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) > a)*(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) < b), sigma_fill*V0*(x - x_c)/(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c)**2*log(b/a)), 0)
